# Bibliography Semantic Audit

**Date:** 2026-10-30
**Bibliography:** refs.bib (7 entries)
**Files scanned:** main.tex and 3 included file(s) (7 unique cited keys)

## Summary

| Check | Critical | Medium | Low |
|---|---|---|---|
| Structural (missing / typos) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Citation drift (duplicates) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| DOI verification | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Style consistency | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Unused entries | - | - | 0 (informational) |

**Verdict: PASS.** No missing citations, no unresolved problems.

## Structural

- Missing entries (cited, absent from the bib files): none; every cited key resolves.

## Citation drift

- Duplicate keys, DOIs and titles: none.

## DOI verification

- 7 of 7 cited entries verified.
- No lookup problems.

| Key | Status | Source | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wang2024 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'A survey on large language model based autonomous agents' |
| Park2023 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior' |
| Sambasivan2016 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Principled workflow-centric tracing of distributed systems' |
| Kaldor2017 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Canopy: An End-to-End Performance Tracing And Analysis System' |
| Mace2015 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Pivot tracing: dynamic causal monitoring for distributed systems' |
| LasCasas2018 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Weighted Sampling of Execution Traces: Capturing More Needles and Less Hay' |
| LasCasas2019 | verified | crossref | title 1.00 vs 'Sifter: Scalable Sampling for Distributed Traces, without Feature Engineering' |

## Style consistency

- Citation commands come from one package; no natbib and biblatex mix.

## Next steps

1. No required fixes.

content.text:
The semantic bibliography audit passed: all 7 cited entries were found in Crossref with exact title matches.

| Check | Critical | Medium | Low |
|---|---|---|---|
| Structural (missing / typos) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Citation drift (duplicates) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| DOI verification | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Style consistency | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Unused entries | - | - | 0 (informational) |

**Verdict: PASS.** No missing citations, no unresolved problems.

- **FAIL / WARN:** none.
- **Existence checks:** the 7 entries are Wang2024, Park2023, Sambasivan2016, Kaldor2017, Mace2015, LasCasas2018 and LasCasas2019. None came back `partial`, `mismatch`, `unreachable` or `not_indexed`.
- **Unused entries:** 0. `refs.bib` has 7 entries and the paper cites all 7.
- **Contact address:** the plugin's Crossref contact setting (`crossref_mailto`) had no value, so the lookups ran without one. That didn't affect the result. Set it in the plugin options if you want lookups to use Crossref's faster "polite" service.

The full report is at `quality_reports/bib_audit_semantic.md`, and the script recorded the bib entry in the commit gate.

Bibliography clean. Run /ploma:compile if the bib file changed since the last build.
